verdict.rationale: Phaser Editor's AI tooling says it can "reorganise a scene into layers" and "rename a bunch of objects" in one step, which is a first-party bulk operation across many scene items. The MCP server's 40+ tools, driven by natural-language agent requests, offer a plausible path for AI-native users to run these operations. Missing for 10: documented scope and mechanics of bulk operations (which item types, selection or filtering, batch editing beyond renaming and layering), explicit confirmation that MCP tools support batch actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
